Maya: Heads-up: Marketing plans to publish the main release post Tue 2025-06-03 09:00 PT. Need final engineering signoff on changelog + benchmark snippets + docs links. Can eng confirm model rollout freeze window and whether the reported 35% perf win vs baseline is safe to publish? Also need docs permalinks for 'rolling-updates' + 'quantization-guide'.

Devon: We can do a code freeze window Mon 06/02 18:00 PT -> Tue 06/03 12:00 PT. No infra changes during that window. The 35% number is from filtered synthetic bench — I'll run the end-to-end client perf tests against canary and post the verified numbers by EOD Mon.

Kevin: Docs links: https://docs.redwood.com/rolling-updates (draft) , https://docs.redwood.com/quant-guide (draft). I'll finalize permalinks and add anchors for 'rollback' and 'compat'.

Sasha: For webinar signups and lead routing: we'll route registrants to SDR queue 'product-webinar-2025' via HubSpot form. Need a copy-approved CTA link. Also is there a dedicated benchmark slide we can get as PNG?

Devon: Copy-approved CTA: yes, use /marketing/ctas/post-announce-webinar?utm=launch — will confirm final path. I'll export a single-slide PNG of the benchmark (95th pct latency + throughput) by tomorrow AM. Quick numbers: canary vs baseline: throughput +18%, median latency -12%, p95 -9% (preliminary).

Maya: Perfect. Kevin, once you have permalinks, drop them here; we'll swap in final links in the post. @Devon please paste the verified bench results when ready. Also please confirm the canary will be the public fallback for 24h.

Devon: Confirmed: canary will be fallback for 24h with auto-roll to stable after 24h if error rate <0.5%. Also scheduled a staged rollout across regions: NA->EU->APAC over 6 hours.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary rollout starting Tue 2025-06-03 08:30 PT. Operator: devops@redwood

Maya: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll hold final send until we have the bench PNG + docs permalinks. If anything blocks, ping me.
